Count.description: Number of items returned in this page.

SizePage.description: Page size used for this response.

items.description: A component of an offer — an on/off switch, a non-resetting limitation, or a consumption counter reset at each renewal — declared once at business level and then attached to offers. Features are scoped to a business, not to a segment.

allOf.description: Business scope of the resource. Required when creating it, read-only afterwards.

IdBusiness.description: Owning business. Set at creation and read-only afterwards, so it is accepted on a create and ignored on an update.

allOf.title: BusinessScopeAttribute

allOf.description: Creation trace of the resource. Set by ProAbono when the record is created, and read-only afterwards.

IdUserCreation.description: ID of the user who created the record.

allOf.title: TraceCreationScopeAttribute

allOf.description: Update trace of the resource. Set by ProAbono on every change.

IdUserUpdate.description: ID of the user who last updated the record.

allOf.title: TraceUpdateScopeAttribute

ReferenceFeature.description: Your identifier for this feature, shared between ProAbono and your application.

allOf.description:
Type of a feature.

* `OnOff` — boolean feature (module access, content access, etc.)
* `Limitation` — counted feature whose quantity is NOT reset at renewal
* `Consumption` — counted feature whose quantity IS reset at each renewal
allOf.title: TypeFeature

TypeFeature.description: Feature type. Set at creation and read-only afterwards: sending it on an update has no effect.

IsVisible.description: Whether shown in offers and hosted pages.

Order.description: Display order among all features in offers and hosted pages. Defaults to the last position.

FamilyCharge.description: Charge family the feature bills under, for example `Digital`. Computed by ProAbono.

KeyCharge.description: Computed charge key — `FamilyCharge_KeyChargeSuffix`, or the family alone when there is no suffix, for example `Digital`.

Metadata.description: Set of key/value pairs attached to the object, up to five keys. Writable at creation and on every update of the parent object. On an update, send a key with an empty value to unset that key, or send an empty value for `Metadata` to clear every key.
Metadata.title: Metadata

StateLife.description:
Life state of a catalogue resource.

* `Ok` — active
* `ToModerate` — awaiting moderation
* `DisabledUser` — disabled by the user
* `DisabledSystem` — disabled by the system
* `DisabledModeration` — disabled after moderation
* `Deleted` — deleted
StateLife.title: StateLife
